attempts.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) using binary release install + systemd units, with firewalld opened for peer/client ports 2380/2379. Verified cross-member read/write replication, verified continued read/write availability with one member down and that member's automatic catch-up on rejoin, then performed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol on all three nodes (one at a time, quorum preserved), confirming changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
